fact: On 8 May 2026 the Ministry of Housing and Lands issued Clarification No 1 on the consultancy for LAVIMS 2.0, whose phases are update of the RFP (16 weeks), procurement exercises, and implementation (100 weeks), all awarded to a single bidder.
title: Consultancy Service for Land Administration and Valuation Information Management System (LAVIMS 2.0) - Clarification No 1
